biography.title: Biography
biography.description: A professional profile covering career, clinical expertise and academic activity.
biography.body: Dr. Mohamed Aggour is a Consultant Interventional Neuroradiologist with more than nineteen years of experience in minimally invasive endovascular neuroradiology, engaged in the treatment and management of brain and spinal vascular diseases.

legalPage.title: Legal & Privacy
legalPage.description: Privacy notice, medical disclaimer, remote consultation terms, and cookie and analytics information.
legalPage.intro: This website is the professional website of Dr. Mohamed Aggour. This page explains how personal information may be collected and used when you visit this website, contact the practice, submit a consultation or referral request, or use related website services.

consultationPage.title: Remote Consultation
consultationPage.description: Share a consultation request for review. This page does not send or store your information.

requester.heading: Who is making this request?
requester.intro: Choose the route that best describes the request.
requester.patientDescription: For a patient or family consultation request.
requester.physicianDescription: For a physician or professional referral.
requester.error: Choose one requester type to continue.

urgency.heading: Is this an emergency?
urgency.intro: The emergency branch ends the normal consultation journey.
urgency.emergencyDescription: Show emergency guidance and stop the normal flow.
urgency.nonEmergencyDescription: Continue to the consultation service options.
urgency.error: Choose Emergency or Non-Emergency to continue.

service.heading: Which service are you considering?
service.intro: This selection is a request preference, not an appointment confirmation.
service.onlineDescription: Request review for an online consultation.
service.clinicDescription: Request review for a clinic visit.
service.error: Choose a service type to continue.

common.heading: Common information
common.intro: Provide only the information needed for a team review. All fields below are optional unless marked otherwise.

patient.heading: Patient / Consultation details
patient.note: Do not include unnecessary medical history, diagnosis requests, medication requests, or treatment decisions.

physician.heading: Physician / Referral details
physician.note: Keep the referral summary concise and limited to information needed for professional review.

times.heading: Preferred dates and times
times.intro: You may provide up to three preferences. No availability is displayed and no appointment is confirmed by submitting a preference.
times.maximum: Maximum of three preferred times reached.
times.notConfirmed: The team reviews preferences and confirms any appointment separately.

attachments.heading: Optional attachments
attachments.intro: You may select up to three files locally on this device. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
attachments.maximum: You can select a maximum of three files.
attachments.invalidType: One or more files were not selected because only PDF, JPG, and PNG are allowed.
attachments.none: No files selected. Attachments are optional.

consent.heading: Consent and privacy acknowledgement
consent.intro: Please read the privacy information before continuing.
consent.error: Consent is required before reviewing the request.

reviewStep.heading: Review your request
reviewStep.intro: Check the details below before completing the request. You can edit any previous step.
reviewStep.notConfirmation: This consultation request does not confirm an appointment, payment, diagnosis, or clinical decision.
reviewStep.validation: Please complete the required branch selections and consent before continuing.

emergency.heading: Emergency guidance
emergency.body: This website is not an emergency service.
emergency.stop: The normal consultation journey stops here. No booking, payment, form, upload, or appointment selection is available in this branch.

success.heading: Request preview complete
success.received: This request has been prepared for review. Nothing was sent to the team or an external provider.
success.payment: Payment is not confirmed or processed.
success.decision: No clinical decision has been made.

errors.email: Enter an email address in a valid format, or leave it blank.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number using digits and common phone separators, or leave it blank.
errors.files: Review the selected files before continuing.
errors.review: Complete the required selections before reviewing the request.
